limitations: This review does not read production sample arrays, run a real fit or score, or report scientific results.
The fixed F0 panel is exposed development data; R3 comparisons are descriptive recipe comparisons, not an isolated end-to-end decoder effect.
The linear moment estimators are unconstrained; this probe cannot establish conditional-moment bounds, learning-state hypotheses, gradient effects, or public generalization.
precision_note: Inherited R2 moment-head prediction outputs are float32 by contract. Fit and decoder arithmetic are float64, and float64 decoded predictions are passed without an extra cast to the unchanged canonical scorer, whose own input path converts to float32. This precision path is disclosed in RESULT metadata.
scope: Independent implementation/package review only; no scientific outcome assessed.
